protocol_packs.title: Attachment and Care Translation Pack
protocol_packs.summary: A translation pack for relating attachment-style outputs to relational care signaling through Love Languages without claiming one-to-one equivalence.
protocol_packs.notes: This pack is useful for relational translation and for checking where care-signaling language and attachment regulation get conflated.

protocol_packs.title: ILENS Core Trait-Motive Stack
protocol_packs.summary: A baseline ILENS bundle spanning Big Five, MBTI, and Enneagram to support multi-layer synthesis across trait scaffold, cognitive-style language, and motive or identity patterning.
protocol_packs.notes: This is the strongest general-purpose starting pack for downstream synthesis because it covers stable trait, style language, and identity or motive-heavy framing in one bundle.

protocol_packs.title: Contextual Core Trait-Motive Stack
protocol_packs.summary: A contextual comparison pack for repeated Big Five, MBTI, and Enneagram slices across time, role, or self-state while keeping stable-versus- adaptive interpretation explicit.
protocol_packs.notes: Use when the same comparative axes appear across more than one slice of a single subject. This pack is not a general pairwise or compatibility pack.

protocol_packs.title: Human Model Card Personality Baseline
protocol_packs.summary: A baseline pack for Human Model Card workflows when the available person evidence includes Big Five, MBTI, and Enneagram material as structured inputs rather than raw narrative alone.
protocol_packs.notes: This pack does not replace the need for broader behavioral corpus evidence, but it gives downstream agents a consistent baseline bundle for model-card synthesis work.

protocol_packs.title: Pairwise Relational Baseline
protocol_packs.summary: A pairwise comparison pack that centers attachment, relational care signaling, and broad trait scaffold without collapsing them into one score.
protocol_packs.notes: This is a disciplined baseline for pairwise or relationship-oriented work. It emphasizes regulation, care signaling, and broad trait context while keeping unsupported relational claims visible.

protocol_packs.title: Symbolic Stack Translation Pack
protocol_packs.summary: A translation pack for Human Design and natal astrology that foregrounds symbolic meaning load, identity adhesion, and non-equivalence rather than empirical flattening.
protocol_packs.notes: This pack is especially useful for symbolic systems that are culturally sticky and interpretively thick but not psychometric in the usual sense.
